lineItems.label: Base price
lineItems.note: Sample rate. Indiranagar apartments were listed at about ₹17,500 to ₹26,500 per sq ft in 2026. Your sale agreement also states the RERA carpet area.

lineItems.label: Floor rise
lineItems.note: ₹40 per sq ft for each floor above the first. This home is on the fifth floor.

lineItems.label: Covered car parking
lineItems.note: One covered bay in the basement, allotted with the apartment.

lineItems.label: Clubhouse membership
lineItems.note: One-time membership of the building's shared amenities.

lineItems.label: Electricity and water connections
lineItems.note: BESCOM and BWSSB connection deposits and fees. The builder collects them and pays the utilities, so no GST is added.

lineItems.label: Legal and documentation charges
lineItems.note: Drafting the sale agreement and the sale deed.

lineItems.label: GST on the home
lineItems.note: Applies to homes bought before the occupancy certificate is issued, with no input tax credit. It is paid with each instalment. Ready homes with the certificate carry no GST.

lineItems.label: GST on legal and maintenance charges
lineItems.note: Standard GST rate on services the builder charges for separately.

lineItems.label: Stamp duty
lineItems.note: Karnataka rate for property above ₹45 lakh. It is charged on the agreement value or the government guidance value, whichever is higher.

lineItems.label: Cess on stamp duty
lineItems.note: A percentage of the stamp duty, not of the property value.

lineItems.label: Surcharge on stamp duty
lineItems.note: Urban rate, inside city corporation limits. A percentage of the stamp duty.

lineItems.label: Registration fee
lineItems.note: Karnataka raised the registration fee from 1% to 2% from 31 August 2025.

lineItems.label: Advance maintenance, 12 months
lineItems.note: ₹4.50 per sq ft a month, paid a year ahead at handover.

lineItems.label: Corpus fund
lineItems.note: One-time fund for major repairs, handed over to the owners' association.

schedule.stage: Sale agreement, covering the structure already built

emiDefaults.rateNote: SBI regular home loans start at 7.50% a year from 15 October 2026. We use 7.75% as a typical rate; yours depends on your credit score and lender.

estimateNote: Estimate. Statutory charges are computed at current Karnataka rates; your lawyer confirms them at registration.
